title: Anri of Astora
snippet:
Anri of Astora -  Dark Souls III - character - notes 
 notes : Anri's gender is dependent of the player's character and is always the opposite to the Ashen One's, as the player will "marry" Anri should they choose to follow Yuria of Londor's questline.
Should the player make Anri and Horace hostile, and then kill Horace, Anri will Collapse and become despondent.
If the player stops the assassin in Irithyll but never kills Horace, the Prism Stone near the Anor Londo cathedral entrance will appear, but no summon sign will appear until Horace has been killed.
Upon Anri's death, the Elite Knight Set will become available for purchase from the Shrine Handmaid.
During the "Usurpation of Fire" ending, Anri can be seen on the right, among the rest of the hollows.

title: Anri of Astora
snippet:
Anri of Astora -  Dark Souls III - character - lead 
 lead : **Anri of Astora** is a character in *Dark Souls III*.

Male Anri is voiced by Adam Sopp, who also voiced Rickert of Vinheim and Vince of Thorolund in *Dark Souls*. Female Anri is voiced by Lucy Briggs-Owen, who also voiced several characters in *Bloodborne*.

title: Anri of Astora
snippet:
In either case, Anri will be wielding a Broken Straight Sword and is hostile to the player. Anri can also buff the sword using a Charcoal Pine Bundle.

Regardless of cause of death, Anri's armor set will be sold by the Shrine Handmaid upon death.

title: Anri of Astora
snippet:
If Anri does not die in the Catacombs, they can next be encountered in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley, at the Church of Yorshka. Here the player can learn Quiet Resolve through dialogue, and Anri will gift them the Ring of the Evil Eye here should they have left the Catacombs without finding out about Horace's fate. Again, Anri's questline can diverge here, depending on action taken against the assassin hidden within the Church of Yorshka:

#If the assassin is killed, Anri will continue on to the final phase of the questline, but Yuria of Londor's questline will end.
#If the assassin is spared, Anri will die at her hand and the questline will end, however Yuria's will continue.

The final part of the questline will begin once Pontiff Sulyvahn has been defeated.

title: Anri of Astora
snippet:
#Should the player leave Horace alive and then inform Anri of his location, Anri will make their way down to the lake and then die by Horace's hand, ending the questline.
#Should the player defeat Horace and then inform Anri of his location (or inform Anri of his location and then immediately go to defeat Horace), the player will receive the Ring of the Evil Eye as a reward and Anri will move on to the next part of the questline.
#Should the player not encounter Horace, or defeat Horace and then withhold information when talking to Anri, they will leave the Catacombs and move on to the next part of the questline once High Lord Wolnir has been defeated.

title: Anri of Astora
snippet:
Anri of Astora -  Dark Souls III - character - lore 
 lore : Anri is one of the two children that managed to escape from Aldrich long ago. Like the Ashen One, Anri is an Unkindled in search of the Lords of Cinder, seeking to slay Aldrich. Anri travels with Horace the Hushed as part of this quest.

title: Anri of Astora
snippet:
Anri of Astora -  Dark Souls III - character - locations 
 locations : Road of Sacrifices — Halfway Fortress bonfire.
Firelink Shrine — after the player defeats the Deacons of the Deep and acquires the Small Doll.
Catacombs of Carthus
# After the Abyss Watchers bonfire, enter the large room connecting the first bridge and the top of the central staircase, and head into a pocket with a balcony where a crystal lizard is found. Four skeletons will awaken after you enter their room, so take caution as you speak to Anri.
# After the Catacombs of Carthus bonfire, to the right of the hanging bridge, in the area with spiky rock formations.
Irithyll of the Boreal Valley — Church of Yorshka bonfire. See the section below for the conditions of this encounter.

title: Anri of Astora
snippet:
Anri of Astora -  Dark Souls III - character - questline 
 questline : The player first encounters Anri at the Road of Sacrifices, near the Halfway Fortress bonfire, alongside Horace the Hushed. Engaging in conversation with Anri will reveal more details about the Crucifixion Woods and Cathedral of the Deep, the lair of Aldrich, Saint of the Deep. Talking to Horace will lead him to gift the player with the Blue Sentinels covenant emblem. After this meeting, both will move on to the Cathedral of the Deep, dropping their summon signs for the boss of the area.

Once the player has acquired the Small Doll, Anri and Horace will appear at Firelink Shrine. Talking to Anri will reveal their next destination to be Irithyll of the Boreal Valley, the true home of Aldrich, which lies beyond Farron Keep. Should Yuria of Londor be present at Firelink Shrine, talking to her will reveal that one of her fellows is guiding Anri to Irithyll, and that she intends for the Ashen One and Anri to wed.

title: Anri of Astora
snippet: After defeating the Abyss Watchers and gaining access to the Catacombs of Carthus, the player can find Anri within the area, alone and distraught from being separated from Horace. The player can help them reunite by locating Horace, and Anri will lay Prism Stones to guide Horace to their reunion. However, unbeknownst to both Anri and the Ashen One, Horace has hollowed within the Smouldering Lake and the quest can either end or continue in one of three ways, once the player has encountered Horace at Smouldering Lake and then found Anri near the rope bridge in Carthus:

title: Anri of Astora
snippet:
The final part of the questline will begin once Pontiff Sulyvahn has been defeated.

If the assassin carries through with her deed, speaking to Yuria of Londor will inform the Ashen One that Anri is ready to become their spouse, and can be found in the lair of the old Darkmoon god. Upon arriving at Gwyn's honorary tomb in Anor Londo, the Old Woman of Londor will greet the Ashen One and present the Sword of Avowal. The player can then proceed into the tomb and perform the wedding ceremony with Anri, gaining three Dark Sigils in the process. If the player returns to the tomb later (or reloads the area), they can find Anri's Straight Sword within the honorary tomb where Anri once was.

title: Anri of Astora
snippet:
If the assassin is stopped, Anri will lay a Prism Stone and a summon sign requesting cooperation in front of the doors of the grand cathedral of Anor Londo. Interacting with this sign will summon the player to aid Anri against Aldrich, Devourer of Gods. Defeating Aldrich in Anri's world will have no effect on Aldrich's status in the player's world, and either can be engaged and defeated in whatever order is convenient to the player.

Once Aldrich is defeated in Anri's world, speaking to Ludleth of Courland will reward the player with Anri's Straight Sword, along with a warning against trying to chase after Anri. The player can then encounter Anri, hollowed, in one of two locations:

#If not told about Horace's location in Smouldering Lake, Anri can be found near the Cathedral of the Deep bonfire, up the hill where the Crest Shield is found.
#If told about Horace's location, Anri can be found at his makeshift grave within Smouldering Lake.

title: Dark Sigil
snippet:
Dark Sigil -  Dark Souls III - item - usage 
 usage : Increases the player's Hollowing level by the number of accumulated Sigils upon death.
Grants bonus Luck when wielding Hollow-infused weapons if Hollowing is 15 or greater, based on the upgrade level of the weapon.
Once eight Dark Sigils are acquired, the Lord of Hollows ending may be unlocked.

title: Dark Sigil
snippet:
Dark Sigil -  Dark Souls III - item - lead 
 lead : The **Dark Sigil** (暗い穴, lit. Dark Hole) is an item in *Dark Souls III*.

title: Dark Sigil
snippet:
Dark Sigil -  Dark Souls III - item - description 
 description : A black, gaping hole in the flesh that resembles the brand of an Undead.

The darkness of humanity seeps from this bottomless pitch-black hole, the gap filled by the accumulation of the curse.

This Dark Sigil will never heal, but there is a tale told of a Fire Keeper who returned from the Abyss, and brought great comfort to a bearer of the curse.

title: Dark Sigil
snippet:
Dark Sigil -  Dark Souls III - item - removal 
 removal : The Dark Sigil can only be healed by giving a Fire Keeper Soul to the Fire Keeper. The cost of healing is equal to the cost of leveling up a number of times equal to however many Dark Sigils have been accumulated. Once healed, all Sigils will be removed from the player's inventory and Hollowing will be reversed.

Yoel of Londor will no longer speak to the player if healed prior to his death. Should they be healed after, Yuria will leave Firelink Shrine upon being spoken to.

As the Dark Sigil is a key item, proceeding to the next New Game cycle will remove them from the player's inventory, but Hollowing will remain unaffected.

title: Dark Sigil
snippet:
Dark Sigil -  Dark Souls III - item - availability 
 availability : Five are given to the player after letting Yoel of Londor draw out their true strength, granting a free level each time. Yoel grants a session at 0, 2, 6, 12 and 15 Hollowing.
Three are granted during Yuria of Londor's questline, once the player completes the Rite of Avowal with Anri of Astora at Anor Londo.

title: Fire Keeper Soul (Dark Souls III)
snippet:
Fire Keeper Soul (Dark Souls III) -  Dark Souls III - item - lead 
 lead : The **Fire Keeper Soul** is a key item in *Dark Souls III*.

title: Fire Keeper Soul (Dark Souls III)
snippet:
Fire Keeper Soul (Dark Souls III) -  Dark Souls III - item - availability 
 availability : Found on the corpse of a fire keeper at the top of the bell tower in Firelink Shrine. The entrance to this tower can only be unlocked by using the Tower Key, sold by the Shrine Handmaid.

title: Fire Keeper Soul (Dark Souls III)
snippet:
Fire Keeper Soul (Dark Souls III) -  Dark Souls III - item - description 
 description : Soul of a Fire Keeper who is said to have returned from the Abyss.

This Fire Keeper preserves the bonfire, and serves its champion. She is said to have soothed and accepted the dark sigil, which has tainted her soul.

And yet, her soul will one day embed itself in the bosom of another Fire Keeper.

title: Fire Keeper Soul (Dark Souls III)
snippet:
Fire Keeper Soul (Dark Souls III) -  Dark Souls III - item - usage 
 usage : Give the soul to the Fire Keeper in Firelink Shrine, thus allowing her to remove dark sigils contracted after leveling up with Yoel of Londor.

title: Horace the Hushed
snippet:
Horace the Hushed -  Dark Souls III - character - locations 
 locations : Road of Sacrifices
Found camping in the Halfway Fortress, along with Anri of Astora.
Firelink Shrine
Both characters are found here after the Deacons of the Deep have been defeated.
Smouldering Lake

title: Horace the Hushed
snippet:
Horace the Hushed -  Dark Souls III - character - description 
 description : Horace is a companion of Anri of Astora and, along with them, one of the only two prisoners who managed to escape from Aldrich's captivity. Unlike his polite and very talkative comrade, Horace limits himself to answer only with grunts and grumbles and never actually speaks.

title: Horace the Hushed
snippet:
Horace the Hushed -  Dark Souls III - character - lead 
 lead : **Horace the Hushed** is a character and enemy in *Dark Souls III*. He is one of only two children to escape Aldrich's clutches, the other being Anri of Astora.

Horace is voiced by Ryan Morris, who voiced Nico of Thorolund in *Dark Souls*, and Messengers and some mobs in *Bloodborne*.

title: Horace the Hushed
snippet: Horace can be seen standing at the bottom of the large chasm below the hanging bridge that leads to High Lord Wolnir. The access to this location can be found via climbing down the bridge after destroying it to access Smouldering Lake, and then navigating a long tunnel on the right side upon entering the lake proper. Upon approach, however, Horace will attack the player (presumably due to hollowing), leaving no other option than to fight back. He wields a regular Halberd, and will use its Charge skill quite often to close the distance.

title: Horace the Hushed
snippet:
Horace the Hushed -  Dark Souls III - character - plot 
 plot : Anri considers Horace to be their loyal friend, a skillful warrior and someone that can be trusted upon. The Ashen One first meets both characters camping near a bonfire in the Road of Sacrifices. Horace gives the Blue Sentinels covenant token to the player upon 'talking' to him. At the end of Cathedral of the Deep, both Horace and Anri may be summoned to battle the Deacons of the Deep. Both characters can be found a second time after the battle (regardless of whether or not they were summoned), resting at Firelink Shrine.

As the Ashen One travels through the Catacombs of Carthus, however, Anri can be found separated from their friend. Visibly concerned for the sake of their friend, Anri asks the Ashen One to come back to them if they learn something about Horace's whereabouts.

title: Liliane
snippet: When an Unkindled attained the strength necessary to usurp the First Flame and absorb its power, Liliane arrived on site together with her sister Yuria, taking her place at the side of the Dark Lord who would unify the Hollows and bring them salvation.

title: Liliane
snippet:
Liliane -  Dark Souls III - character - description 
 description : The third daughter Liliane, one of the founders of the Sable Church, is said to recount tales that portray the suffering and conflict of Hollows.

title: Liliane
snippet: Liliane bore responsibility for developing Londor's culture and religion that would be considered anathema by the Way of White faith. As a founder of the Sable Church, Liliane weaved tales that portrayed the suffering and conflict of Hollows, to whom the Church aimed to bring salvation. These tales were recounted in dark miracle tomes which were forbidden in the rest of the world, on account of offering salvation to Hollows and conversely cursing all living beings. Londor espoused the veneration of the occult, and their tales/miracles were consequently focused on Hollows themselves, antithetical to the Way of White religion built around the gods of Anor Londo. The utility of the miracles derived from tales of Londor ranged from combative to deceptive, and were accompanied by Velka's ancient miracles recovered by the Sable Church.

title: Liliane
snippet: Liliane is a founding mentor of the Sable Church, and the youngest sister to Elfriede and Yuria. The three sisters at one point entered into the service of the Primordial Serpent Kaathe, becoming his maidens. The Primordial Serpent taught them his art of the Dark Hand, which could sap the essence of its victims. The sisters pursued Kaathe's goal of ending the Age of Fire founded by the gods and ushering the Age of Dark, and searched for a Dark Lord whom they would empower to usurp the First Flame and use its powers to lead humans into a new age. To this end, the three sisters used their battle prowess to establish the Sable Church, an organization that claimed to offer salvation to Hollows. The Church became a haven for those with unsavory or blurry pasts, along with other rejects of the Age of Fire. An increasing number of Undead and Hollows flocked to the Church, forming a society of wretchedly aged, deceitful, deeply detested Hollows. Their realm would be known as Londor, where

title: Liliane
snippet:
Liliane -  Dark Souls III - character - lead 
 lead : **Liliane** is a mentioned character in *Dark Souls III*. She can be briefly seen in the "The Usurpation of Fire" ending, alongside her older sister Yuria of Londor, to whom she appears identical.

title: Orbeck's Ashes
snippet:
Orbeck's Ashes -  Dark Souls III - item - lead 
 lead : **Orbeck's Ashes** are a key item in *Dark Souls III*. They are one of several umbral ashes that can be found throughout the course of the game.

title: Orbeck's Ashes
snippet:
Orbeck's Ashes -  Dark Souls III - item - notes 
 notes : If Orbeck's questline has been completed, giving the ashes to the Shrine Handmaid will only add the spells with 0 stock, as they have already all been purchased in order to complete the questline.
The Clandestine Coat is unlocked for purchase from the Shrine Handmaid upon Orbeck's death, not upon obtaining the ashes or giving them to the Shrine Handmaid.

title: Orbeck's Ashes
snippet:
Orbeck's Ashes -  Dark Souls III - item - description 
 description : Umbral ash of Orbeck of Vinheim. With this, the shrine handmaid will prepare new items.

Orbeck was fascinated with sorcery but without means, so offered to serve as an assassin in exchange for acceptance into the Dragon Academy, believing that one day he could reinvent himself as a sorcerer.

title: Orbeck's Ashes
snippet:
Orbeck's Ashes -  Dark Souls III - item - availability 
 availability : Dropped by Orbeck of Vinheim.
Alternatively, they can be found on Orbeck's corpse in the Grand Archives upon the completion of his questline and defeating the Twin Princes.

title: Orbeck's Ashes
snippet:
Orbeck's Ashes -  Dark Souls III - item - usage 
 usage : Extends the Shrine Handmaid's inventory to include items sold by Orbeck of Vinheim upon his death, i.e. his Sorceries.
Can be given to Yuria of Londor to receive the Morion Blade.

title: Rickert of Vinheim
snippet:
Rickert of Vinheim -  Dark Souls - character - plot 
 plot : Rickert is the first blacksmith players can access, although he can be hard to find if he isn't specifically sought after. Rickert is also a blacksmith who can repair damaged weapons and armor, and ascend weapons down the Magic path (up to +5) by default. He can give players early access to spells and spell tools, but both Big Hat Logan and Griggs offer better prices and better spells. During the later phases of the game, Rickert is most valuable for his unique upgrade paths, Magic and Enchanted, which become accessible after finding the Large Magic Ember and the Enchanted Ember respectively.

title: Rickert of Vinheim
snippet:
Rickert of Vinheim -  Dark Souls - character - location 
 location : He is found stuck behind bars by the end of a staircase at the beginning of New Londo Ruins.

title: Rickert of Vinheim
snippet:
Rickert of Vinheim -  Dark Souls - character - lead 
 lead : **Rickert of Vinheim** (ヴィンハイムのリッケルト) is a character in *Dark Souls*. He is a blacksmith by trade. He is voiced by Adam Sopp, who also voiced Vince of Thorolund, as well as the male Anri of Astora in *Dark Souls III*.

title: Rickert of Vinheim
snippet:
Rickert of Vinheim -  Dark Souls - character - lore 
 lore : Rickert was exiled from Vinheim, presumably because of his undeath. Not much is known about him except that he considers Big Hat Logan to be a legend dating back to "a hundred years ago".

title: Rickert of Vinheim
snippet:
Rickert of Vinheim -  Dark Souls - character - strategy 
 strategy : The only way to hurt Rickert is through the use of a long weapon, such as the Titanite Catch Pole or Demon's Spear. While Rickert does not fight back, it is easy to fall off the ledge accidentally. As Rickert can also be hurt by Wrath of the Gods using it is safer since it does not require movement.

title: Ring of the Evil Eye (Dark Souls III)
snippet:
Ring of the Evil Eye (Dark Souls III) -  Dark Souls III - ring - single_player 
 single_player : The Ring of the Evil Eye is an excellent way of conserving healing items or spells, and excels when used against groups of weak enemies due to healing the same amount regardless of how powerful the enemy is. Because of the way it procs against multiple kills, it is best to kill enemies one at a time if the goal is to recover health.

title: Ring of the Evil Eye (Dark Souls III)
snippet:
Ring of the Evil Eye (Dark Souls III) -  Dark Souls III - ring - description 
 description : This ring captured the foul spirit of an evil eye, a creature that ravaged Astora.

Absorb HP from each defeated foe.

The horrid spirit nearly destroyed Astora, but was eventually defeated by "the sword of one most noble."

title: Ring of the Evil Eye (Dark Souls III)
snippet:
Ring of the Evil Eye (Dark Souls III) -  Dark Souls III - ring - online_gameplay 
 online_gameplay : This ring can be very potent depending on the area. Because the effect procs no matter who gets the kill, a phantom can gain the benefit from the host or an allied phantom killing an enemy, and an invader can profit from the host's party killing enemies to get to the invader. In either case, it can be a very helpful way to maintain health due to possessing less health and half the Estus of a Host of Embers.

title: Ring of the Evil Eye (Dark Souls III)
snippet:
Ring of the Evil Eye (Dark Souls III) -  Dark Souls III - ring - effect 
 effect : ***Ring of the Evil Eye**: Restores 30 HP per enemy killed.
***Ring of the Evil Eye+1**: Restores 33 HP per enemy killed.
***Ring of the Evil Eye+2**: Restores 35 HP per enemy killed.
***Ring of the Evil Eye+3**: Restores 37 HP per enemy killed.

title: Ring of the Evil Eye (Dark Souls III)
snippet:
Ring of the Evil Eye (Dark Souls III) -  Dark Souls III - ring - lead 
 lead : The **Ring of the Evil Eye** is a ring in *Dark Souls III*.

title: Ring of the Evil Eye (Dark Souls III)
snippet:
Ring of the Evil Eye (Dark Souls III) -  Dark Souls III - ring - mechanics 
 mechanics : Any enemy dying will proc the health restore effect, including ones that die due to other players or the environment. However, other players dying will not activate the effect, even if the wearer dealt the killing blow. Additionally, the heal doesn't account for multiple enemies being killed within a short period of time or by a single attack.

The effect can be stacked with Arstor's Spear to heal an additional 30 HP per kill.

title: Ring of the Evil Eye (Dark Souls III)
snippet:
Ring of the Evil Eye (Dark Souls III) -  Dark Souls III - ring - availability 
 availability : ***Ring of the Evil Eye**
**Given by Anri of Astora within the Catacombs of Carthus, if the player tells them the whereabouts of Horace the Hushed.
**Alternatively, Anri will give the ring to the player in the Church of Yorshka if they are not told of Horace's location.
***Ring of the Evil Eye+1** (NG+)
**Found in the Cathedral of the Deep behind the giant concealed statue, right before the Deacons of the Deep.
***Ring of the Evil Eye+2** (NG++)
**Found in the High Wall of Lothric, in a corner behind some barrels in the room where the Cell Key and the first Estus Shard are found.
***Ring of the Evil Eye+3** (The Ringed City)
**Guaranteed drop from a Mimic found within the Shared Grave area, at the bottom of the stairwell where the Moaning Knight is fought.

title: Sword of Avowal
snippet:
Sword of Avowal -  Dark Souls III - item - usage 
 usage : Used to conclude Anri of Astora's questline.

Interacting with Anri's body in front of Gwyn's tomb will play a cutscene where the player plunges the sword into his/her body, concluding with this the rite of wedlock that will presage the coming of a true hollow lord.

title: Sword of Avowal
snippet:
Sword of Avowal -  Dark Souls III - item - availability

It is said that a rite of wedlock will presage a true Hollow lord.

Your spouse's name is Anri, who patiently awaits a rightful lord, deep within the mausoleum.

title: Vince of Thorolund
snippet:
Vince of Thorolund -  Dark Souls - character - trivia 
 trivia : 5 humanity can be obtained using the Dark Hand, if used on him before he goes hollow.

title: Vince of Thorolund
snippet:
Vince of Thorolund -  Dark Souls - character - plot 
 plot : Vince and Nico are the bodyguards of Reah of Thorolund. He will appear with his companions in the Firelink Shrine after the player beats the Capra Demon in the Lower Undead Burg. Unlike his mumbling companion, Vince will have a brief conversation with the player. In it, he tells the player that his party are going on a quest, but reveals little more.

If the player does not exhaust all of his and Reah's dialogue, they will leave Firelink Shrine when the player defeats Pinwheel in The Catacombs.

The player next encounters Vince and Nico as Hollowed enemies in the Tomb of the Giants, in the pit that Patches kicks them into. The player must defeat them in order to rescue Reah.

title: Vince of Thorolund
snippet:
Vince of Thorolund -  Dark Souls - character - strategy 
 strategy : Vince and Nico are pretty much straight melee fighters. They have above average health, hit fairly hard, and the fact that they fight together may cause problems for the player. The player must also fight them in near-pitch darkness; the Skull Lantern, Sunlight Maggot helmet, or the Cast Light sorcery will greatly aid players in this aspect. Vince casts miracles including Force and Heal. Force can disrupt your block and drain your stamina quickly, while letting heal get out of hand can make the fight go on for ages.

An alternative (and far easier) way of defeating the two is to lure them to the edge of the area where bone towers spawn. From here, using the 'force' miracle multiple times will force one, if not both of them, off the map, leaving the remaining one to be dealt with relative ease.

title: Vince of Thorolund
snippet:
Vince of Thorolund -  Dark Souls - character - lead 
 lead : **Vince of Thorolund** (ヴィンス) is a minor character in *Dark Souls*. He is voiced by Adam Sopp, who also voiced Rickert of Vinheim, as well as the male Anri of Astora in *Dark Souls III*.

title: Yuria of Londor
snippet:
Yuria of Londor -  Dark Souls III - character - description 
 description : Having three founders of the Black Church ensured Yuria's legacy would survive. Her two sisters could carry the torch, making certain their lord claims the flame, for the sake of all Hollows.

title: Yuria of Londor
snippet:
Yuria of Londor -  Dark Souls III - character - notes 
 notes : Yuria will leave Firelink Shrine if the player talks to her after healing their accumulated Dark Sigil. If the player does not engage in dialogue with her after healing their Dark Sigils, Yuria will remain in Firelink Shrine indefinitely, though this serves no practical purpose.
Yuria only drops her ashes if the player kills her. As such, defeating the Soul of Cinder will mean that her wares are no longer available, unless she is killed before she has a chance to leave.

snippet:
Yuria of Londor -  Dark Souls III - character - ashes_of_ariandel 
 ashes_of_ariandel : Yuria possesses additional dialogue should the player progress through the Painted World of Ariandel. After talking to Sister Friede and returning to Firelink Shrine, Yuria will recognize the scent of her sister, and warn the Ashen One of heeding their kindness over their principles.

Once Sister Friede has been defeated and the player is in possession of her soul, Yuria will remark on Elfriede's history with Londor, and request that the Ashen One usurp the First Flame in her memory.

Should the player have not yet acquired 8 Dark Sigils in either case, the dialogue will vary slightly.

title: Yuria of Londor
snippet:
Yuria of Londor -  Dark Souls III - character - base_game 
 base_game : Upon introducing herself, Yuria reveals that Yoel was a close friend to her and thanks the Champion of Ash for allowing him to be redeemed through his actions while at their service. She then does the same, pledging allegiance to the player and accepting them as her Lord and of all the hollows in Londor, in the hope that one day the Ashen One brings back its glory to the world.

Upon talking to her, the player will learn the "Dignified Bow" gesture.

Once Orbeck of Vinheim has moved to Firelink Shrine, Yuria will alert the player that he has proclaimed himself to be "Lord of Hollows," asking the player to settle the matter lest he imperil the player's rule. If the player brings Orbeck's Ashes to Yuria, she will reward them with the Morion Blade.

title: Yuria of Londor
snippet:
Yuria of Londor -  Dark Souls III - character - location 
 location : Found in Firelink Shrine, at the end of the corridor on the west wing of the basement, in the same area where Yoel of Londor is found.

In order for Yuria to appear, the player must draw out their true strength (level up) with Yoel and acquire all five Dark Sigils before reaching the Catacombs of Carthus. The next time the player visits Yoel's usual place in Firelink Shrine, they will find him already dead with Yuria standing close by.

title: Yuria of Londor
snippet: Once the player reaches the Catacombs of Carthus, Yuria reveals that she is also guiding Anri of Astora along the path to Irithyll of the Boreal Valley, and plans to engage him/her (gender is always the opposite of the player's) in matrimony. To this end, the player must aid Anri and keep him/her alive up until Pontiff Sulyvahn has been defeated (care must be taken not to kill the Londor Pilgrim within the Church of Yorshka). If successful, Anri may be found in the old Darkmoon tomb, Dark Sun Gwyndolin's boss arena in *Dark Souls*, and can be "married" here, gaining 3 more Dark Sigils for a total of 8.

title: Yuria of Londor
snippet:
Conversely, if the player has not turned Yuria hostile, the Londor Pale Shade will become available for summoning in the aforementioned areas.

Yuria will disappear if Anri dies at any point before Pontiff Sulyvahn.

Completing Yuria's questline by Linking the First Flame while possessing 8 Dark Sigils unlocks the Usurpation of Fire ending.

title: Yuria of Londor
snippet:
Yuria of Londor -  Dark Souls III - character - lead 
 lead : **Yuria of Londor** is a character and merchant in *Dark Souls III*. She is a mentor of the Sable Church and accomplished swordswoman, said to have claimed a hundred lives with her sword, the Darkdrift.

She is voiced by Pooky Quesnel, who also voiced Arianna in *Bloodborne*.

title: Yuria of Londor
snippet:
Once the player completes their wedding vows, Yuria will swear her fealty to the true Lord of Hollows. She will no longer become aggressive if attacked by the player, short of the Dark Sigils being healed by the Fire Keeper. She will also make herself available to be summoned for the Soul of Cinder fight. Should she be summoned and survive this fight, her set and weapon can be found at her usual spot at Firelink Shrine.

If Yoel dies before the player can attain all five Dark Sigils, Yuria will not appear and the Londor Pale Shade will invade in the Farron Keep and Irithyll of the Boreal Valley; the Pale Shade will also invade the player at these locations should Yuria be killed or angered. Defeating the Pale Shade once will reward the Manikin Claws, while defeating them at both locations will cause the Pale Shade Set to appear at Firelink Shrine in the same area where Yuria and Yoel used to reside.

title: Yuria of Londor
snippet:
Yuria of Londor -  Dark Souls III - character - trivia 
 trivia : Yuria's line upon death: "Kaathe... I have failed thee" can be better translated as "Kaathe... Your dying wish was unfulfilled", implying that the Primordial Serpent died of unknown causes before the events of *Dark Souls III*.
Yuria's armor set, in particular the helmet, is based on the Cainhurst Set from *Bloodborne*. Additionally, the Cainhurst Vilebloods also used katanas.
Yuria shares her name with Yuria the Witch, a character from *Demon's Souls*.
**Yuria and Yuliya are names commonly used in Miyazaki directed games, minus Sekiro.
Yuria wields Darkdrift, a katana originally from *Dark Souls II*. It too belonged to an NPC that delved in the shadows and spoke for Hollows.
Like Oswald of Carim from *Dark Souls*, she wears an armor set called the "Black Set" and she sells Velka Miracles in the Londor Braille Divine Tome, Purging Stones, and Rings of Sacrifice.

title: Ending (Dark Souls III)
snippet:
** If the questline is being followed, the Londor Pale Shades will be available as summonable phantoms throughout the game; if the quest has been voided, they will invade as Dark Spirits instead.
** If all conditions for The Usurpation of Fire endings have been fulfilled, Yuria will be a summonable phantom for the Soul of Cinder boss fight, as will a Londor Pale Shade.
** Anri has in fact two mutually exclusive questlines; should the player not aim to complete the Londor questline, they can kill the Old Woman of Londor disguised as a statue in the Church of Yorshka to allow for Anri's other questline instead.

title: Ending (Dark Souls III)
snippet:
Defeat Pontiff Sulyvahn and return to Firelink Shrine. Exhaust Yuria's dialogue to confirm that Anri awaits the player within Darkmoon Tomb.
Head to the Darkmoon Tomb, located right before the elevator leading to Anor Londo. There, a pilgrim of Londor will give the Sword of Avowal. Continue down the hall to find Anri on a sacrificial mat. Use the action button to activate a cutscene (the pilgrim outside the room will be dead afterwards; this is normal).
Talk with Yuria at Firelink Shrine and exhaust her dialogue.
The questline is now complete: After defeating the Soul of Cinder, simply interact with the First Flame to trigger this ending.

title: Ending (Dark Souls III)

At this point, it is best to ensure that the player has talked to Yuria of Londor at least once and exhausted her dialogue, where she will inform the player of an upcoming wedding ceremony between the Ashen One and Anri.
Talk to Anri in the Church of Yorshka bonfire in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley. Be sure to exhaust their dialogue, receiving the "Quiet resolve" gesture.

snippet:
Old Woman of Londor -  Dark Souls III - character - notes

If the player attacks the Old Woman while she is disguised, but does not kill her, she offers additional dialogue (shown below).

The questline is now complete: After defeating the Soul of Cinder, simply interact with the First Flame to trigger this ending.

If the player wishes to ensure that the Usurpation ending will be triggered, they may return to Firelink Shrine at any time and talk to Yuria. Unless she voices her displeasure with the Ashen One, this will confirm that The Usurpation of Fire ending will take place upon interacing with the First Flame instead of the To Link the First Flame ending.

title: Eygon of Carim
snippet: Irina's questline can end in two ways: her "good" questline takes place if the Ashen One provides her with all non-dark miracle tomes and purchases the associated miracles. This will lead Irina to finally achieve her dream of becoming a Fire Keeper, relocating to the bottom of one of the towers outside the Shrine. After this, Eygon can be summoned for the Dragonslayer Armour boss fight; once the boss is slain (even if he was not summoned) and Irina has become a Fire Keeper, Eygon's dead body can be found in the cell Irina was originally found. It is unclear how he died, although the fact that he returned to the place he had abandoned Irina might indicate suicide out of guilt for failing to believe in her.

snippet:
** Yoel is now dead, and Yuria of Londor will have moved into Firelink Shrine next to his body, informing the player that Anri is being guided by one of her fellows.
Further into the Catacombs, speak with Anri on a spot to the side of the bridge leading to High Lord Wolnir. title: Yoel of Londor
snippet: "Drawing Out True Strength" five times is necessary to complete Yoel's questline, which, together with the subsequent Yuria of Londor questline, lead to The Usurpation of Fire ending. It must be done before reaching the Catacombs of Carthus, since if Yoel is still alive when the player reaches said location, he will die the very moment the Catacombs are entered (including in the Settlement if he has not been recruited). If Yoel dies without having "Drawn Out True Strength" five times, or if the player heals their Dark Sigils with the Fire Keeper after she receives the Fire Keeper Soul, the Londor questline will have failed.

title: Eygon of Carim
snippet: The second outcome of Irina's questline happens if any dark miracle is purchased from her after giving her a forbidden tome, leading her to succumb to "darkness" and Eygon to kidnap her in a rescue attempt. This will also lead him to appear hostile next to the Iudex Gundyr bonfire, guarding Irina. She will not even be able to feel the Ashen One's touch, unless they are wearing Eygon's gauntlets, which lead her to mistake them for Eygon and asking "Eygon" to fulfill his promise to mercy kill her.

title: Ending (Dark Souls III)
snippet:
Ending (Dark Souls III) -  Dark Souls III - mechanic - lead 
 lead : __NOTOC__

There are four **endings to *Dark Souls III***.

All four endings require the Ashen One to first gather the cinders of four great lords to reach the Kiln of the First Flame, where they must defeat the Soul of Cinder. Only the first ending does not require actions beyond strictly the main questline, although it is possible for up to three to be available simultaneously at the Kiln. All endings revolve around the First Flame, symbolized by a special bonfire that can be interacted with upon slaying the Soul of Cinder.

title: Ashen One
snippet:
Ashen One -  Dark Souls III - character - road_of_sacrifices_and_crucifixion_woods 
 road_of_sacrifices_and_crucifixion_woods : Following the road leads the Ashen One to the Crucifixion Woods, where they encounter Anri of Astora and their companion Horace the Hushed. Anri seeks Aldrich, and thinks to find him in the Cathedral of the Deep. They offer their help to the Ashen One, should the Ashen One need it. Here the Ashen One may also find Orbeck of Vinheim, a sorcerer who will offer to share his knowledge if the Ashen One brings him magic scrolls.

Making their way through the Crucifixion Woods leads the Ashen One to a crossroads. One path leads to Farron Keep, home of the Abyss Watchers, whereas the other one, guarded by one of the Crystal Sages, leads to the Cathedral of the Deep, home of Aldrich.

title: Astora
snippet: The country of Astora is heavily influenced by the culture of the gods of Anor Londo and subservient to their ideal of continuing the Age of Fire through the sacrifice of a Chosen Undead. The legend of the Chosen Undead is known to Astoran nobility, including the family of Oscar, an Astoran knight who travelled to the Northern Undead Asylum in order to free an Undead who could then make pilgrimage to Lordran and link the fading Flame. Solaire of Astora, an adherent of the cult of Gwyn's firstborn, finds himself in Lordran in his quest to reach Anor Londo; Undead Prince Ricard of Astora had the same goal, but went hollow before he could reach the city. Anastacia of Astora serves as the Firekeeper of Firelink Shrine and Andre of Astora serves as a blacksmith in the Undead Parish, both of them welcoming the Undead that arrived at Lordran in search of Flame.

title: Evil Eye
snippet:
Evil Eye -  Dark Souls III - character - dark_souls_iii 
 dark_souls_iii : Legends of the vanished kingdom of Astora and the Evil Eye that destroyed it still circulate in Lothric, and so do the rings that imprisoned it. One of them is in the possession of Anri, a knight who attached their identity to the fabled land despite never having lived there or seen it. Even in this era, its power of life-absorption remains.

title: Ending (Dark Souls III)
snippet:
Ending (Dark Souls III) -  Dark Souls III - mechanic - availability_2 
 availability_2 : {'name': 'Ending', 'description': 'Having witnessed visions of a world without the First Flame, the summoned Fire Keeper takes the First Flame into her hands, where she lets it wither and die out entirely. The light in the sky quickly fades together with the Flame and soon as the world descends into complete darkness, ending the Age of Fire.\n\nAlthough the world has now entered the long-postponed Age of Dark which would have naturally succeeded Fire had Lord Gwyn not started the tradition of linking the First Flame prior to the original *Dark Souls*. The shape that this new Age of Dark will take, and the part that the Unkindled One will play within it, are left unclear.'}

title: Age of Dark
snippet: Through another questline, the player can cooperate with Yuria, a leader of the Sable Church of Londor, who urges the Ashen One to take the Flame for themselves, to usher in an Age of Dark; for the Sisters of the Sable Church were under the guidance of Kaathe. This is Ending 4: "The Usurpation of Fire", where the Flame is wrested by the Ashen One, who is to lead the Age of Man as the Lord of Hollows. By the time of *Dark Souls III*, the undead curse has been accepted by the people of Londor, who have come to view it as a blessing, and their Hollow form as the "true face of man".

 description : Armor said to have been given to elite knights of fallen Astora.

The mere mention of Astora invoked wistful pangs, and perhaps it was such a dream that drew Anri to this faraway home known only by name.

title: Ashen One
snippet:
***Ash Seeketh Embers**: If the Ashen One gave the Eyes of a Fire Keeper to the Fire Keeper, they may summon her upon defeating the Soul of Cinder. The Fire Keeper will take the First Flame into her hands. Before the flames fade, the Ashen One may strike her down. The Ashen One steps over the limp body of the Fire Keeper and takes the First Flame into their own hands. Kneeling, the Ashen One raises the flame, offering it to the Darksign Sun.
***The Usurpation of Fire**: If the Ashen One allowed Yoel to draw out their true strength a sufficient amount of times through the Dark Sigil, followed Yuria's instructions and "married" Anri, the Ashen One may, instead of linking the fire, absorb it into themselves. The Ashen One collapses from the strain and awakens before a Darksign Sun turned white, and also finds Yuria, Anri, and an army of hollows greeting them as their Lord and praying for the Ashen One to make Londor whole.

title: Fire Keeper Soul
snippet:
Obtained after killing Darkmoon Knightess at the first bonfire of Anor Londo. Killing her extinguishes the bonfire.
Obtained after defeating Knight Lautrec of Carim through the Black Eye Orb in Anor Londo. Players may choose to either return the soul to its owner, restoring the Firelink Shrine bonfire; obtain humanity from it; or offer it to another Fire Keeper, increasing the power of their Estus Flasks.

title: Andre of Astora
snippet:
Andre of Astora -  Dark Souls - character - plot 
 plot : Often the first blacksmith new players come across, Andre of Astora can be a welcome sight. Andre of Astora is the only blacksmith that can ascend weapons down the Standard path from +5 to +6 and from +10 to +11. He is also the only blacksmith that can ascend weapons down the Raw, Divine and Occult paths.

He also sells some basic upgrade materials, as well as many weapons (some of which are unique to him). Finally, he sells the Crest of Artorias, which is required to open the door to Darkroot Forest, a more dangerous section of Darkroot Garden.

In *Dark Souls III*, he acts as the blacksmith in Firelink Shrine. At the beginning he is unable to infuse weapons without the correspondent coals found through the game to expand his services. Once the player has found a coal, returning it to him will unlock new infusion options.

title: Anor Londo
snippet:
Anor Londo -  Dark Souls - location - firekeeper_s_vengeance 
 firekeeper_s_vengeance : If the player frees Lautrec of Carim, and allows him to live after reaching Blighttown, they will find that Anastacia of Astora, keeper of the Firelink Shrine bonfire, had been murdered. Examining her remains will grant the dingy clothing set (notable for its curse and poison resistance) and a Black Eye Orb to the player's inventory.

If the player arrives on the platform between the stairs opposite where the Silver Knight is located, the Orb will begin to resonate. It can then be used as an item to transport the player as a Spirit of Vengeance to Lautrec's realm. He will be accompanied by a mage and a pikeman. Lautrec's bodyguards only stand in the way, as he is main target, and is the only one who possesses items. Once killed, he will drop a single Humanity, a Souvenir of Reprisal, the Soul of Anastacia of Astora, and a Ring of Favor and Protection.

title: Ashen One
snippet: Within the city, the Ashen One may encounter Shira, Knight of Filianore, who asks the Ashen One to put down Midir, a mighty dragon who once served the Gods, but who has now been consumed by the Dark. Fighting their way through the city, the Ashen One finds Midir and sends him hurtling down a chasm. Chasing Midir to his lair, the Ashen One may fulfill Shira's request and fight him to the death. In the Church of Filianore, the Ashen One finds Judicator Argo who bars the way to Filianore. He will summon Halflight, Spear of the Church to fight the Ashen One.

title: Chosen Undead
snippet: Once in Anor Londo, the player makes their way into the Anor Londo cathedral, where they face Dragonslayer Ornstein, of the Four Knights of Gwyn, and Executioner Smough. The Chosen Undead triumphs over them and gains access into the chamber of Gwynevere, where they are greeted by the Princess and awarded the Lordvessel. When Frampt sees that the player had completed their quest, he declares the prophecy set in motion and that the character is indeed the incarnation of the Chosen Undead.

title: Age of Dark
snippet: In Ending 2: "The End of Fire", the First Flame is snuffed out, albeit with the Fire Keeper revealing that one day "tiny flames will dance across the darkness", which suggests that the First Flame partially perseveres in the form of embers within the Lords of Cinder of the past. As these Lords will use these embers of the First Flame to exert influence the world, this Age of Dark does not spell finality for the Flame. Alternatively, the player can choose to intervene as the Fire Keeper is about to extinguish the First Flame, by killing her before the cinematic ends. In this ending, the Ashen One instead takes the First Flame for themselves while the final segment of the opening narration is heard: *"Nameless, accursed Undead, unfit even to be cinder...And so it is...that Ash seeketh embers."*

title: Hollowing
snippet:
Hollowing -  Dark Souls III - mechanic - healing_the_dark_sigil 
 healing_the_dark_sigil : The more permanent option for curing Hollowing is to obtain the Fire Keeper Soul and give it to the Fire Keeper. The player must then pay a soul cost equal to the amount of souls they would pay to level up from their current level, by a number of levels equal to the amount of Dark Sigils held. Thus, if the player is high level and has accepted the additional Dark Sigils from Anri of Astora's wedding, the price for healing the Dark Sigil can be extremely high.

Healing the Dark Sigil is permanent, as it will remove all held Dark Sigils and reset Hollowing to zero. Because of this, it will break the alliance with Yuria of Londor, as the Dark Sigils are required for obtaining the Usurpation of Fire ending.

title: Ending (Dark Souls III)
snippet:
Also of note regarding this questline:
** Giving the Eyes of a Fire Keeper to the Fire Keeper does not void the questline; if they did so, the player must however avoid summoning her using the sign next to the First Flame bonfire, as doing so will lead to another ending.
** Although it is not recommended as there are no benefits, it is actually fine to kill Yoel after obtaining five Sigils from him; he welcomes this death, and Yuria's dialogue is unaffected.
** Although Yuria requests of the Ashen One to kill Orbeck of Vinheim if he has arrived in the Shrine, this is unrelated to the questline and not necessary to this ending.
** Unlike the other two Pilgrims, the Stone-humped Hag atop The Dreg Heap is unrelated to the questline and can be killed freely without consequences.
** If the questline is being followed, the Londor Pale Shades will be available as summonable phantoms throughout the game; if the quest has been voided, they will invade as Dark Spirits instead.

title: Ending (Dark Souls III)
snippet:
Ending (Dark Souls III) -  Dark Souls III - mechanic - ending_2 
 ending_2 : The Ashen One strikes the Fire Keeper down before the First Flame is completely extinguished, then tramples her limp body and takes the First Flame from her hands. Kneeling, the Ashen One raises the Flame towards the sun obscured by a fire-dripping eclipse that resembles the Darksign.

Although the meaning of this ending is ambiguous, it likely symbolizes that the Ashen One acquires the power of the First Flame's power for themselves rather than in accordance with any of the great powers at play. The Usurpation of Fire ending also sees the Ashen One acquiring the First Flame rather than link it or let it die, although the absence of the followers of Londor in this ending hints that the Ashen One's plans are their own.

title: Ending (Dark Souls III)

 availability_3 : This secret ending (which has no official name) is unlocked by , in the very last moment the player is actionable while the Fire Keeper has the First Flame in her hands,

This ending, despite being considered an alternative The End of Fire ending, does not unlock the latter's achievement, nor any other.

title: Ending (Dark Souls III)
snippet:
Ending (Dark Souls III) -  Dark Souls III - mechanic - ending 
 ending : Fulfilling the purpose for which they were brought back to life, the Ashen One links the First Flame and becomes a Lord of Cinder. The Flame connects with their body, slowly setting them ablaze as they sit beside the bonfire.

Although in theory, this leads to a continuation of the once-glorious Age of Fire, this linking of the Flame is but a shadow of the linking as can be performed by the Chosen Undead in *Dark Souls*, echoing the significant weakening of the First Flame, which instead of engulfing the Kiln into an explosive blaze of fire remains weak, barely kindled anew. The world remains dim and covered in ash, with the sun still obscured by a fire-dripping eclipse that resembles the Darksign, further exemplifying that this prolonged Age of Fire will pale when compared to days of old.

title: Chosen Undead
snippet:
Chosen Undead -  Dark Souls - character - epilogue 
 epilogue : After offering the necessary Lord Souls, the doors to the Kiln of the First Flame are opened to the Chosen Undead. Gwyn, now reduced to a Lord of Cinder, breathes his last breath in the final confrontation with the Chosen Undead. It is here that the Chosen Undead may make their decision of either linking the flame or walking away from it. Depending on which course of action is taken, one of the two possible endings will be unlocked. Whether the player has aligned themselves with Kaathe or Frampt will not affect the ending of the game.

***Link the Fire:** This ending is unlocked if the player rekindles the First Flame. The Chosen Undead offers themselves as kindling to the fire. Sacrificing all of their souls, the Chosen Undead is consumed by the flames and the Age of Fire is extended, as life is breathed into the First Flame once more.

title: Yoel of Londor
snippet:
Yoel of Londor -  Dark Souls III - character - lead 
 lead : **Yoel of Londor** is a character and merchant in *Dark Souls III*. He is voiced by David Sterne.

A gentle, soft-spoken pilgrim of Londor who relocates to Firelink Shrine after being met in the Undead Settlement, he offers the Ashen One his wares as sorcerer as well as a unique, "free" way to level up in souls up to five times. Doing so prior to reaching the Catacombs of Carthus is a requirement for the Londor questline (see The Usurpation of Fire ending).

title: Ending (Dark Souls III)
snippet:
Must not, in the Catacombs, tell Anri of Horace's location : doing so will result in Anri being killed by the hollowed Horace.
Must not kill the Old Woman of Londor at the Church of Yorshka, where, if the questline is being followed, she is disguised as a statue in a corner where several real statues are situated (attacking without killing her will not fail the questline).

title: New Game Plus (Dark Souls III)
snippet:
New Game Plus (Dark Souls III) -  Dark Souls III - mechanic - access 
 access : Upon defeating the Soul of Cinder and choosing an ending, the player will be offered to enter New Game+. If they decline, they will arrive back at Firelink Shrine and will be free to continue exploring the game as normal. New Game+ can then be entered at any time from Firelink Shrine's bonfire. This process is repeated for each subsequent New Game+ cycle.

Note that immediately entering the next New Game+ cycle will prevent the player from accessing events that only occur after the defeat of the Soul of Cinder, such as Yuria of Londor leaving her armor set and weapon for the player to collect following the Usurpation of Fire ending.

title: Bone Fist
snippet:
Bone Fist -  Dark Souls II - weapon - trivia 
 trivia : The strong attack of the Bone Fist, where the player does a jab and a sweeping kick resembles Andre of Astora's attack from *Dark Souls*, if the players aggros him.

title: Yoel of Londor
snippet:
Yoel of Londor -  Dark Souls III - character - notes 
 notes : Upon reaching the Catacombs of Carthus, Yoel will die and his services will no longer be available, ending his questline prematurely unless the player has gotten all five Dark Sigils from him.
**Yoel dies exactly the moment the "Catacombs of Carthus" banner appears on the screen, so it is perfectly safe to fight the Abyss Watchers beforehand and use the bonfire that appears after the battle, as long as the player does not descend the staircase that opens in that room. If you don't level up with him at all before he dies, it will cause the failure of Yuria's questline and the Londor Pale Shade to invade at two different points of the game.

title: Ending (Dark Souls III)
snippet:
Must their Dark Sigils with the Fire Keeper after she receives the Fire Keeper Soul (the player Purging Stones or "Request Dissolution" at either the Shrine of Velka in the Undead Settlement or the Purging Monument in The Ringed City); doing so will be perceived as a betrayal by Yuria, leading her to either never appear or rebuke the Ashen One upon their next interaction.
Must not proceed into the Catacombs of Carthus before acquiring 5 Dark Sigils (defeating the Abyss Watchers or interacting with the bonfire which spawns upon their defeat before acquiring the Sigils does not void the questline, but is not recommended in order to avoid accidents).
** Entering the Catacombs will cause Yoel to die, and whether Yuria arrives in Firelink Shrine or not will indicate if the steps were successfully taken. if Yuria does not spawn upon his death, it means that the questline has failed.

title: Old Woman of Londor
snippet:
Old Woman of Londor -  Dark Souls III - character - questline 
 questline : If the player is following either Anri or Yuria's questline, the Old Woman will first appear in the Church of Yorshka in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley. There, she will be disguised as a statue via use of the Chameleon spell, where she can be interacted with, ignored, or killed. Killing her or leaving her alive each yield their own consequences.
Should the player leave the Old Woman alive, Anri's questline will end and the Old Woman will next appear outside the Darkmoon Tomb, under Anor Londo. She will present the player with the Sword of Avowal and urge them inside the tomb. Upon using the sword and exiting the tomb, her corpse will lay where she stood, and on it will be the Chameleon sorcery.

title: Chosen Undead
snippet:
Chosen Undead -  Dark Souls - character - artorias_of_the_abyss 
 artorias_of_the_abyss : In the *Artorias of the Abyss* DLC the Chosen Undead travels back in time to the ancient realm of Oolacile, where they discover the truth about the death of the Knight Artorias and the fall of Oolacile. The quest presented in this DLC is completely optional and therefore, it is not required to complete the game.

title: Sunless Set
snippet:
Sunless Set -  Dark Souls III - armor - availability 
 availability : Purchased from the Shrine Handmaid for a total of 23,000 souls once Sirris of the Sunless Realms has died, whether she is killed by the player or upon completion of her questline.

title: Londor Pale Shade
snippet:
Londor Pale Shade -  Dark Souls III - character - lead 
 lead : The **Londor Pale Shade** is a dark spirit and summonable phantom in *Dark Souls III*.

Assassins faithtul to Londor, Pale Shades will be either enemies or allies depending on whether or not the Ashen One has voided The Usurpation of Fire ending route; if they haven't, a Pale Shade can be summoned for three different boss battles, but if they do, the Shades invade as dark spirits instead.

title: Ending (Dark Souls II)
snippet:
Ending (Dark Souls II) -  Dark Souls II - mechanic - after_the_credits 
 after_the_credits : Regardless of the ending chosen, the player is warped to Majula, allowing them to finish any remaining business. The player may then begin the next New Game+ from the Far Fire.

title: Age of Dark
snippet:
Age of Dark -  Dark Souls - storyline - lore 
 lore : The Age of Dark begins when the First Flame fades completely, thus ending the Age of Fire and the rule of the gods that gained their power from it.
Since the Flame continues to burn until it goes out naturally, the Dark Age should have arrived, as naturally, when it had exhausted its fuel.

Despite the Age of Dark being a ubiquitous concept throughout the *Dark Souls* series, it is never the "current" state of the world in any of the existing games. Each of the *Dark Souls* games takes place during a late point in the Age of Fire, a point which could theoretically lead to the beginning of the Age of Dark, but which does not do so during the normal course of gameplay, with one possible exception.

title: Ending
snippet:
Ending -  Dark Souls - mechanic - the_dark_lord 
 the_dark_lord : This ending is obtained after exiting the arena where the Chosen Undead felled Gwyn instead of lighting the bonfire. All the primordial serpents bow before the new ruler, the Chosen Undead, who has thus become the "Dark Lord". By choosing this ending, the Age of Fire is relinquished and Darkstalker Kaathe's goal of starting the Age of Dark is fulfilled.

title: Company of Champions
snippet:
Company of Champions -  Dark Souls II - mechanic - how_to_join 
 how_to_join : The player can join this covenant as soon as they arrive to Majula. Going between the houses of Lenigrast and Shalquoir, a ledge extending from the cliffside can be found which leads to the Victor's Stone. Upon interacting with the stone, the player must confirm multiple times that they are certain about joining the covenant, and doing so will have them recieve the Champion's Tablet.

title: Ludleth of Courland
snippet:
Once the player places the last Cinder of a Lord on its respective throne in Firelink Shrine and kneels before the bonfire, Ludleth will burn to cinders. Transposition of boss souls will be available by interacting with his throne.
**However, if the player has not given Ludleth the Transposing Kiln prior to performing the ceremony, transposition of boss souls will be unavailable for that playthrough. The only way to unlock transposition is to proceed to the next playthrough.
If Anri of Astora's questline is completed, Ludleth will give the player Anri's Straight Sword when talked to.
**As with soul transposition, if the final ceremony is performed, it will become unavailable.
If the player brings Ludleth one each of Lorian's Greatsword and Lothric's Holy Sword, both without having upgrades applied, a new entry will appear when talked to, consuming both swords to forge the Twin Princes' Greatsword.

title: Ending (Dark Souls II)
snippet:
Ending (Dark Souls II) -  Dark Souls II - mechanic - lead 
 lead : In *Dark Souls II*, there are two endings from which the player may chose: **Proceed to Throne** or **Leave Throne**. The Proceed to Throne ending was the default ending until *Scholar of The First Sin* version was released, and was the default in the original *Dark Souls II* before the "Scholar of the First Sin" update.

title: Anri's Straight Sword
snippet:
Anri's Straight Sword -  Dark Souls III - weapon - availability 
 availability : Dropped by Anri of Astora upon killing them.
Found on Anri's corpse in Smouldering Lake if they are told of Horace's location without killing him.
Given to the player by Ludleth of Courland after assisting Anri in defeating Aldrich, Devourer of Gods in their world.
**If following this method and Ludleth dies before the player obtains the sword, it will become unobtainable.
Found within Gwyn's honorary tomb in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley if Yuria of Londor's questline is being followed. After performing the marriage ritual on Anri's corpse, reload the area.
